$comment: Plan W10.B13 (audit W1.3, W1.4, W1.11, W1.14, W1.26, W2.2, W8.2, 4.15, W5.5, W2.10): the origin of every golden-set part and every test fixture. synthetic = written or generated here (including real text with errors we injected); real = data someone else made, used as published; derived-from-docs = real documents with items (questions, summaries, layouts) written here. Unknown provenance counts as synthetic. src/__tests__/origins.test.ts keeps this complete; scripts/golden/origin-claims.mjs flags plan statuses that call a synthetic set real. Sets under eval/synthetic (not golden: no CI-only test split, and synthetic) are listed under "synthetic", every part of them with origin synthetic.
